scope: Current Phase6 native completed-player-prefix and raw-ball journal integration only; worker/session implementation not frozen or reviewed

checks.finding: Restored branch supplies initial court landmarks/calibration/canonical points, homography flags, registration/calibration/transform views, candidate frames, role boxes, camera-enabled/recovery flags and crop provider required by later stages. Fresh-only intermediate variables have no later consumers.

Restored branch opens sealed prefix and does not call initial court prediction, player pass, role selection or audit writer constructors. Source frame zero is decoded only for metadata/geometry validation.

Selected player checkpoint path and full clean crop execution record are compared to saved record. finish_tracking_for_crops receives saved resolved device as both admitted and expected device; active extractor is rebound to provider.
Selected ball model is moved to saved crop device, observed device is checked and adapter device is set explicitly before journal opening and new candidate inference.

extract_candidates completes its full fixed-tile call before journal.append(global index,candidates); empty frames are retained. Journal API commits row/frontier together. No filter receives the journal as mutable storage.

After suffix reaches declared total frames, all raw journal records extend fresh BallCandidateSequence scratch. Stationary/pixel/patch/detour filtering and temporal association then rerun globally rather than concatenating interpreted chunks.

Fresh sequential suffix decoder closes on normal completion and BaseException. Concurrent close failure adds a note while original inference/storage exception is re-raised. Prefix and journal are owned by outer ExitStack.

metrics.json and returned inference_resume record are rebuilt from current branch/frontier counts and shared provider record. No previous whole-file metrics/result is loaded. Old artifacts can remain after an interrupted later stage; pipeline alone does not publish a completed generation.

recommendations.finding: The existing dynamic-registration/event-authority prohibition is enforced only in the fresh branch. Restored branch assumes the externally bound configuration preserves authority=False.
recommendations.impact: Worker identity binds effective config and protects the normal worker path. A direct trusted caller reusing an external identity with authority=True can bypass the preexisting fresh-run restriction; move/reapply guard outside the branch to preserve standalone pipeline contract.
recommendations.suggested_fix: Check native dynamic-registration event-authority restriction before fresh/restored branching or explicitly in restored branch; include a no-model-call resumed control.
